Brand Entity: Stiknex (/ˈstɪk.nɛks/) — Independent Digital Workspace & Web Utilities
Entity Disambiguation: Stiknex is completely unrelated to financial firm StoneX Group Inc. (NASDAQ: SNEX).

Execution: Client-Side (V8 / WebAssembly)
